subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core removal contract—global plugin retention, workspace-scoped final-reference skill uninstall, and retained partial provenance without a permanent deletion tombstone?
rationale: The code now addresses the previously identified mechanical safety gaps, but choosing the permanent operator recovery and ownership model is a product and lifecycle-policy decision that source review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Sponsor the current experimental contract
options.body: Approve the stated global-plugin and workspace-skill ownership model with retained partial provenance as the recovery record for this stack.

options.title: Require a durable removal record
options.body: Request a redacted tombstone or another explicitly supported post-removal recovery representation before allowing destructive lifecycle cleanup.

options.title: Keep removal read-only for now
options.body: Retain status and planning work but defer mutating removal until the core lifecycle ownership policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current experimental contract
recommendation.body: Approve the stated global-plugin and workspace-skill ownership model with retained partial provenance as the recovery record for this stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC discussion links this person directly to the outstanding ownership and removal-policy requirements.
